documents.title: AI Dashboard auth-service architecture and data contracts

sections.heading: Context
sections.body: auth-service supports the AI Dashboard by normalizing operational telemetry, authorization context, and deployment metadata for enterprise tenants.

sections.heading: Key Interfaces
sections.body: Primary interfaces include the tenant-scoped REST API, the metrics event stream, the dashboard read model, and the audit event sink.

sections.heading: Reliability Notes
sections.body: AI Platform owns SLO review, circuit-breaker thresholds, schema compatibility, and rollback readiness for staging releases.

documents.title: AI Dashboard operations review notes for analytics-worker

sections.heading: Discussion
sections.body: The operations review focused on analytics-worker, open support escalations, and recurring evidence gaps across tickets AIDASH-1004, AIDASH-1021.

sections.heading: Decision
sections.body: The team agreed to prioritize trace correlation for timeout and authentication incidents.

sections.heading: Action Items
sections.body: Data Platform will publish owner rotation updates, validate alert thresholds, and confirm all deployment logs include tenant and trace identifiers.

documents.title: AI Dashboard release plan for model-insights-service dev

sections.heading: Scope
sections.body: The release updates model-insights-service for dev with dashboard query tuning, freshness indicators, and improved incident correlation metadata.

sections.heading: Readiness Gates
sections.body: Required gates include migration dry run, API p95 latency check, SSO smoke test, rollback rehearsal, and support knowledge-base validation.

sections.heading: Risks
sections.body: Main risks are tenant-specific feature flags, warehouse replication lag, and mismatched schema versions between analytics workers and dashboard APIs.

documents.title: AI Dashboard deployment procedure for admin-console

sections.heading: Pre-Deployment
sections.body: Confirm admin-console image digest, database migration status, feature flag plan, and active incident freeze exceptions before starting the deployment.

sections.heading: Execution
sections.body: Deploy to canary, wait for health probes, compare dashboard synthetic checks, promote gradually, then capture trace and audit samples.

sections.heading: Rollback
sections.body: Rollback must disable new dashboard flags, restore the previous image, and verify that deployment logs are linked to the active release ticket.

documents.title: AI Dashboard incident report for vector-search-gateway degradation

sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: vector-search-gateway experienced degraded behavior in production. The event was linked to tickets AIDASH-1013, AIDASH-1030.

sections.heading: Root Cause
sections.body: A stale permission cache blocked valid users after an SSO group mapping change.

sections.heading: Corrective Actions
sections.body: Add synthetic coverage, enforce deployment evidence capture, update runbooks, and create follow-up backlog items for unresolved monitoring gaps.
